agents.title: AI agents
agents.description: Let AI tools such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor or VS Code work with your servers through Vaultport using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Everything stays on this device: agents connect locally, never see your passwords or keys, and you approve what they do.
agents.desktopOnly: AI agents connect to Vaultport on your computer. Turn this on in the desktop app.
agents.listening: On: agents on this computer can connect
agents.readOnlyHint: Agents can only list and read; they cannot run commands or change files
agents.hostsHint: Which saved hosts agents can see and use
agents.setupHint: vaultport works as an MCP server: add it to your AI tool once. The tool starts it when needed; Vaultport opens if it is not running.
agents.noActivity: Nothing yet. Every agent action is listed here.

approval.title: {{client}} wants to act
approval.description: An AI agent connected to Vaultport asks for permission.
approval.sessionHint: "Allow for this session" allows this action on this host until the agent disconnects or the vault locks.
approval.policyHint: Actions that change something always need your approval

ai.description: Turn plain-language requests into shell commands with a small model that runs entirely on this device. Nothing you type leaves your computer.
ai.enableHint: Downloads the model once; works offline afterwards
ai.neverAutoRun: Generated commands are never run automatically. Review before pressing Enter.
ai.privacy: Local AI runs on-device with llama.cpp. No prompts, terminal content or telemetry are sent anywhere.
ai.prompt: Describe what you want to do
ai.promptPlaceholder: e.g. find the 10 largest files in /var/log
ai.title: Local AI
ai.useSelection: Use selected terminal text as context

forwarding.autoStart: Start automatically when the vault unlocks
forwarding.description: Tunnels through SSH. Double-click a rule to start or stop it.
forwarding.dynamicHint: Turn this device into a SOCKS5 proxy for any destination
forwarding.emptyDescription: Reach services that are only available from a server, or share a local service with it.
forwarding.exposedWarning: This tunnel will be reachable from other machines on your network.
forwarding.hostHint: The tunnel goes through this host (and its jump hosts)
forwarding.label: Label
forwarding.localHint: Access a service that is unreachable from here
forwarding.remoteHint: Provide access to a service on this device

hostKey.changedDescription: The host key of {{host}} is different from the one you trusted before.
hostKey.mitmWarning: Someone could be intercepting your connection (man-in-the-middle attack), or the server was reinstalled. Only continue if you can verify the new fingerprint with the server administrator.
hostKey.revokedDescription: This host key has been marked as revoked. The connection was blocked.
hostKey.unknownDescription: This is the first time you connect to {{host}}. Compare the fingerprint with the one published by the server administrator.

hosts.agentForwardingHint: Lets this server use your keys for onward connections. Only enable for servers you trust.
hosts.emptyDescription: Add your first server, or import hosts from ~/.ssh/config, PuTTY and other clients.
hosts.envVarsHint: Sent on connect. The server must allow them with AcceptEnv.
hosts.groupInheritanceHint_one: Settings below apply to {{count}} host in this group and its subgroups unless they override them.
hosts.groupInheritanceHint_other: Settings below apply to {{count}} hosts in this group and its subgroups unless they override them.
hosts.jumpHostsHint: Connect through these hosts in order (ProxyJump)
hosts.label: Label
hosts.legacyHint: SHA-1, ssh-rsa and other weak algorithms for very old servers
hosts.moshHint: Survives network changes and sleep. Requires mosh-server on the host.
hosts.noKeys: No keys in your keychain yet
hosts.omnibox: Find a host or type ssh user@hostname…
hosts.passwordStored: A password is stored. Type to replace it.
hosts.postQuantumHint: ML-KEM / sntrup761 hybrids, with automatic fallback
hosts.strictHostKeyHint: Refuse unknown hosts instead of asking
hosts.telnetWarning: Telnet is unencrypted. Use only on trusted networks.

import.cloudNote: Credentials stay on this device and are never synced. Use read-only credentials.
import.csv: Spreadsheet with label, address, port, user, group and tags
import.description: Bring your hosts, keys and known hosts from other clients.
import.detect: Choose a file and detect the format…
import.openssh: Hosts, jump hosts, forwards and identity files from ~/.ssh/config
import.putty: Sessions and tunnels from a PuTTY registry export
import.result: Imported {{hosts}} hosts, {{groups}} groups, {{keys}} keys and {{knownHosts}} known hosts.
import.securecrt: Sessions and folders from a SecureCRT XML export
import.title: Import

keychain.emptyKeysDescription: Generate an Ed25519 key, import an existing one, or use a FIDO2 security key.
keychain.exportDescription: Appends the public key to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the server with safe permissions.
keychain.generateDescription: The private key is generated on this device and stored encrypted in your vault.
keychain.identityDescription: An identity bundles a username with a password and keys so many hosts can share it.
keychain.importDescription: OpenSSH, PEM (PKCS#1/PKCS#8) and PuTTY keys are supported.
keychain.intro: SSH keys and identities, shared across your hosts and stored encrypted.
keychain.keyTypeHint: Ed25519 is fast, small and supported by all modern servers
keychain.label: Label

knownHosts.description: Host keys you trust. Every connection is verified against this list to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks.
knownHosts.emptyDescription: Host keys are added here when you trust a server on first connect.

lock.createDescription: Your hosts, keys and passwords are encrypted on this device with XChaCha20-Poly1305. Nobody, including us, can recover a forgotten master password.
lock.pairDescription: On your other device open Settings → Sync & backup → Pair a device, then enter the pairing text and code shown there.
lock.pairPayloadHint: Copy the text under the QR code, or scan it with your phone camera and paste it here.
lock.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. A long passphrase is best.
lock.restoreDescription: Choose a .vaultport file. It becomes a new vault on this device protected by the backup passphrase.
lock.serverless: No account. No cloud. No telemetry. Your data never leaves your devices unless you set up sync to storage you own.
lock.promiseEncrypted: Hosts, keys and passwords are sealed with XChaCha20-Poly1305 under your master password.
lock.promiseServerless: Nothing to sign up for and no telemetry. Vaultport never talks to a server of ours.
lock.promiseSync: Keep devices in step through storage you already own, end-to-end encrypted.

logs.description: The most recent session per host is kept, encrypted. Bookmark a log to keep it permanently.
logs.emptyDescription: SSH, Telnet, serial and local sessions are recorded here when logging is enabled.

nav.label: Vault sections
nav.noConnectionsHint: Tap a host in your vault to connect.

serial.description: Connect to a device over a serial port (USB adapter, console cable).
serial.title: Serial console

settings.aboutText: A free, open-source and serverless SSH client. Your data is encrypted on your devices and only synced to storage you control.
settings.animatedBackgroundHint: A slowly moving glow in the colors of the preset. Always still when your system asks for reduced motion.
settings.autocompleteHint: Suggestions from history, snippets, the commands installed on the machine, paths, git branches, scripts and more than 200 command specs. Remote files are read over an SFTP channel of the same connection. No AI.
settings.deviceUnlockHint: Keeps an unlock key in the system key store
settings.execChannelsHint: Opens an extra SSH channel. Disable for servers with MaxSessions 1.
settings.intro: Preferences for this device. They are stored encrypted in your vault.
settings.lockOnBackground: Lock when the app is in the background
settings.lockOnSleepHint: Locks as soon as the computer wakes up
settings.osc52Hint: Lets programs like tmux and vim copy to your clipboard
settings.presetHint: Sets the accent and the glow. Works with both light and dark themes.
settings.remoteTitles: Let programs set the tab title
settings.shellIntegrationHint: Command blocks, exit codes, the working directory for new tabs and better suggestions. Loaded automatically into local bash, zsh and fish; over SSH, use “Enable command blocks in this session” in the command palette, or the option below.
settings.storedEncrypted: Settings are stored encrypted in your vault.
settings.recordSessionsHint: Encrypted recordings of terminal output. Keyboard input is not recorded.
settings.localShellHint: Program for local terminals, e.g. /bin/zsh or pwsh.exe. Leave empty for the system default.
settings.shortcutsHint: Click + and press a key combination to add a shortcut; hover a shortcut to remove it. Terminal shortcuts take the key away from the shell, so remove any you need there (for example Ctrl+R for the shell's own history search).

sftp.chooseHostHint: Browse files on this device or any of your hosts. Drag files between the panes to copy them.

snippets.variablesHint: Use {{a}} or {{b}} for values you are asked for before running

sync.addTargetDescription: Choose storage you own. Everything is encrypted before it leaves this device.
sync.backupDescription: Export your vault to a single encrypted file protected by its own passphrase, or import one.
sync.description: Sync your vault between your devices through storage you control. Changes merge automatically without conflicts.
sync.devicesDescription: Show a QR code and a pairing code to set up another phone, tablet or computer.
sync.e2eNote: The storage provider only ever sees encrypted, integrity-protected data.
sync.exportDescription: The file is encrypted with Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305.
sync.filePassphraseHint: At least 8 characters. You need it to import the file.
sync.folderHint: Any folder synced by another app works
sync.importDescription: Data from the file is merged into this vault.
sync.noTargets: No sync targets yet. Your vault lives only on this device.
sync.pairDescription: On the new device choose “I already have a vault” → “Pair with another device”, scan this code and enter the pairing code.
sync.title: Sync
